top_deficiency_types.title: Ensure drugs and biologicals used in the facility are labeled in accordance with currently accepted professional principles; and all drugs and biologicals must be stored in locked compartments, separately locked, compartments for controlled drugs.
Safeguard resident-identifiable information and/or maintain medical records on each resident that are in accordance with accepted professional standards.
top_deficiency_types.category: Resident Assessment and Care Planning Deficiencies

top_deficiency_types.title: Develop the complete care plan within 7 days of the comprehensive assessment; and prepared, reviewed, and revised by a team of health professionals.
top_deficiency_types.category: Resident Assessment and Care Planning Deficiencies

top_deficiency_types.title: Assess the resident completely in a timely manner  when first admitted, and then periodically, at least every 12 months.
top_deficiency_types.category: Resident Assessment and Care Planning Deficiencies

top_deficiency_types.title: Assess the resident when there is a significant change in condition
top_deficiency_types.category: Resident Assessment and Care Planning Deficiencies

top_deficiency_types.title: Prevent the use of unnecessary psychotropic medications or use medications that may restrain a resident's ability to function.
top_deficiency_types.category: Freedom from Abuse, Neglect, and Exploitation Deficiencies

top_deficiency_types.title: Ensure a licensed pharmacist perform a monthly drug regimen review, including the medical chart, following irregularity reporting guidelines in developed policies and procedures.
Procure food from sources approved or considered satisfactory and store, prepare, distribute and serve food in accordance with professional standards.
